views.rationale: AAPL's Services segment grew 18% YoY, outpacing AMZN's 12% growth in net service sales.
AAPL's 9% YoY growth in Americas net sales outpaced BAC's 1% decline in sales and trading revenue.
AMZN's 12% YoY growth in net service sales far exceeded BAC's 1% decline in sales and trading revenue.
BA's cost of sales decreased by 2% YoY, driven by lower volume across all segments.
CAT's operating profit improved $279 million YoY, driven by lower period costs and favorable variable manufacturing costs, while CVX's production cost was not mentioned in the filing.

GOOGL's other income (expense), net, increased $143 million from 2015 to 2016, while GS's net revenues were 9% lower in 2016 due to lower net revenues in Investing & Lending and lower net revenues in Investment Banking, Institutional Client Services and Investment Management.
KO's gross profit margin decreased 0.4% from 2015 to 2016, while JNJ's cost of products sold as a percent to sales decreased to 30.2% from 30.7% as compared to the same period a year ago.
MSFT's revenue increased $294 million or 1% in the three months ended December 31, 2016, while JPM's net revenue was $12.0 billion, a decrease of 1%.
